symptom: `change $P (CreatedAt = if $P/CreatedAt = empty then [%CurrentDateTime%] else $P/CreatedAt)` failed check with E009 "the value assigned to it is a String"; mxbuild builds it (0 errors). The bare `change $P (CreatedAt = [%CurrentDateTime%])` passed.
cause: argKind typed a top-level date token as DateTime and sent everything else to inferKind, which calls every token a String; an `if` reached inferKind, whose first known branch (the token) made the whole `if` a String.
insight: **A refinement applied only at the root does not reach into the expressions that contain it**: argKind's token rule had to recurse into `if` branches and parentheses. Combine branches so that `empty`/unknown say nothing and disagreement is unknown, never a provable mismatch. The same change makes the reverse case — a DateTime `if` assigned to a String — refused, which it was not before.
